name: Round1 Bowling & Arcade Coronado Center
description: Round 1 is a vibrant karaoke bar offering private rooms with a lively atmosphere suitable for families and groups. The venue features a broad song library, including Japanese arcade-style songs, and a sound system that provides clear, loud audio. It caters to both casual singers and those wanting a private experience, with options for food, drinks, and alcohol. Open late, it’s perfect for fun nights out with friends or family gatherings, emphasizing a welcoming environment and modern entertainment.
